reason: Reworks how the widely-used UserDisplayName shape renders (mutating shape Type/Alternates in-place to render twice) and removes bound Title/DisplayType properties from the public UserDisplayNameTagHelper API, which could subtly break admin screens or third-party modules that customize this shape/tag helper across many modules (Contents, AuditTrail, Indexing, UrlRewriting, Dashboard).
